definitions.explanation: White or light-colored clothing and linen, treated as a separate load from colored items when doing laundry. Usually contrasted with {色物|いろもの}.

Large household appliances such as refrigerators, washing machines, and air conditioners, so called because they were traditionally sold in white casings. Almost always used in the compound {白物家電|しろものかでん}.

examples.japanese: {白物|しろもの}だけ{先|さき}に{洗|あら}う。
{色物|いろもの}と{白物|しろもの}を{分|わ}けて{洗濯|せんたく}してください。
examples.english: Please separate the colors from the whites when you do the laundry.

examples.japanese: {白物|しろもの}は{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}を{使|つか}うと{黄|き}ばみが{取|と}れる。
examples.english: Using bleach on whites will get the yellowing out.

examples.japanese: {白物家電|しろものかでん}が{売|う}れている。
{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しを{機|き}に{白物家電|しろものかでん}を{買|か}い{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I took the move as a chance to replace my major appliances.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は{白物家電|しろものかでん}の{分野|ぶんや}で{国内|こくない}トップのシェアを{持|も}っている。
examples.english: This company holds the top domestic market share in the white goods sector.

notes:
Sense 1 belongs to everyday laundry vocabulary; sense 2 belongs to retail and business reporting, where it appears almost exclusively as {白物家電|しろものかでん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白物|しろもの}と{色物|いろもの}: whites and colors
- {白物|しろもの}を{洗|あら}う: to wash the whites
- {白物家電|しろものかでん}: white goods; major home appliances
- {白物家電|しろものかでん}メーカー: white goods manufacturer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {色物|いろもの}: colored items — the laundry counterpart of sense 1
- {黒物家電|くろものかでん}: brown goods — TVs and audio-visual equipment, the counterpart of sense 2
